youtube.baslik: In CHARGE syndrome, why may sitting and walking be delayed? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: In CHARGE syndrome, the most characteristic inner ear finding is underdeveloped or absent semicircular canals. So vestibular function is often markedly reduced, and head control, sitting and walking may be delayed. Because the auditory nerve may also be underdeveloped, imaging the nerve is important when a cochlear implant is considered.
